Coastal projects under 'Blue Economy' raise livelihood concerns

A panel in Chennai has stated that projects under the 'Blue Economy' initiative pose a threat to the livelihoods of coastal communities. Fishers in Tamil Nadu have voiced concerns, asserting that these initiatives are leading to the privatization of coastal areas. The core issue revolves around the potential impact of economic development projects on traditional fishing communities and their access to coastal resources.
